defects.description: AC-4 says a missing e-mail is rejected with 400 and a message containing 'Email is invalid'. When the email property is omitted from POST /users the AUT answers 400 with the misleading message 'Email address is already in use' (an empty string or a malformed e-mail does give 'Email is invalid').
defects.evidence: POST /users {"firstName":"Jane","lastName":"Doe","password":"Qa!7xK9mPz"} -> 400 {"message":"Email address is already in use"} (probed 4 times, 2026-09-27). Controls: email "" -> 400 'User validation failed: email: Email is invalid'; email "notanemail" -> 400 '... Email is invalid'; email null -> 400 'Expected a string but received a null'.

defects.description: AC-7 requires a 401 with a JSON body whose 'error' field says the e-mail or password is incorrect. The AUT answers 401 with an empty body (Content-Length: 0, no JSON) for both a wrong password and an unknown e-mail. The 'same response for both cases' part is met.
defects.evidence: POST /users/login {email: <registered>, password: 'Wrong!Pass9'} -> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized, Content-Length: 0; POST /users/login {email: 'qa-author-nobody-x@example.com', ...} -> 401, Content-Length: 0; POST /users/login {} -> 401 empty (probed 3 times).

traps: The PO comment overrides the description: the password minimum is 7, not 8. A 7-character password (e.g. 'Qa!7xK9') is accepted with 201 and that is CORRECT; flagging it as a deviation from the description's 'at least 8' is a false positive. 6 characters -> 400 '... shorter than the minimum allowed length (7)'.

Case-insensitive e-mail (comment): sign-up with an upper-case variant of an existing address -> 400 'Email address is already in use' (met); sign-in with an upper-case variant -> 200 (met). The AUT stores e-mails lower-cased, so GET /users/me returns the lower-cased address for AC-9: a test that typed a mixed-case e-mail must compare case-insensitively (typing a lower-case unique address avoids the issue).

D1 only shows when the 'email' property is OMITTED from the JSON body. The UI always sends email: '' and then correctly gets 'Email is invalid', so the UI part of AC-2 passes; an evaluator that only tests empty strings will miss D1.
The 'already in use' check runs before validation for an omitted e-mail; do not mistake D1 for a data-dependent duplicate: it reproduces on every call, regardless of the other fields.

Validation messages are Mongoose-style, e.g. 'User validation failed: firstName: Path `firstName` is required., lastName: Path `lastName` is required., email: Email is invalid, password: Path `password` is required.' The UI shows this text verbatim in span#error; AC-2 only asks that every field is mentioned.
Password is never returned (user object has _id, firstName, lastName, email, __v) - met.
Sign-up and sign-in set a 'token' cookie; the UI reads the token from document.cookie. The token returned by sign-up is valid immediately.
Wrong UI sign-in text is 'Incorrect username or password' (met) - the story quotes it exactly.
The UI has no data-testid attributes; elements have ids (#firstName, #lastName, #email, #password, #submit, #signup, #error).
AC-7 is not a 'rejected without status' gap: the story states 401 and a JSON body; the missing body is a deviation, not an open question.
expectations: AC-1 PASS: Sign up button -> /addUser; valid submit -> /contactList with h1 'Contact List'.
AC-2 PASS: empty form -> stays on /addUser, #error lists firstName, lastName, email, password.
AC-3 PASS: POST /users -> 201 {user:{_id,firstName,lastName,email,__v}, token}, no password.

AC-4 FAIL (D1) - the rest of AC-4 is met: 20-char names and 7- and 100-char passwords accepted; 21-char names, 6- and 101-char passwords, empty/malformed e-mail and missing names/password -> 400 with field-specific messages.
AC-5 PASS: duplicate (any case) -> 400 'Email address is already in use'; the UI shows the same text.
AC-6 PASS: login -> 200 {user, token}; GET /users/me with it -> 200.
AC-7 FAIL (D2): 401 status and identical responses are met, but there is no JSON error body.
AC-8 PASS: 'Incorrect username or password' shown, URL stays '/'; correct password -> /contactList.
AC-9 PASS: a UI-created account can POST /users/login (200) and GET /users/me returns the entered names and the (lower-cased) e-mail.
